viral_sprint.goal: 1,000 subs (Path A) or 10M Shorts views/90d (Path B) in ~60 days; current pace 2.5 subs/day - sprint must raise it
viral_sprint.visibility: public immediately after QA PASS; 'review mode' restores private+18:00 slots
topic_archetypes_ranked: fear/health-scare with real documented case reports (sleep in contacts, staring at the sun, too much water)
gross-but-fascinating inside stories (tonsil stones, belly button stone)
famous myth-busts everyone argues about (sneeze with eyes open, 5-second rule)
extreme scenarios (never sleep, sit 24 hours, hold everything)
viral_sprint.hook_rule: the stakes must be stated in the FIRST spoken second; final line ends on a specific cliffhanger or direct question to drive comments
viral_sprint.packaging_rule: title <=55 chars stating the stakes; thumbnail one giant recognizable element + <=3 words; never reuse the same hook structure twice in a row
viral_sprint.quality_rule: user flagged graphics quality 2026-11-15: prefer full-res GPU render (res=1 aa=4 shadow=2048, tested working); software-GL flags stay as fallback if GPU glitches reappear; sheet review PASS still mandatory

render_engine.name: faceless-shorts (deep-dive style)
render_engine.why: Intel HD 620 GPU path glitches black rectangles; software-GL is deterministic

upload.publish_at_note: VIRAL SPRINT 2026-11-15: videos go PUBLIC immediately after QA PASS (user mandate 'grow it fast'); publishAt slots disabled for the sprint; say 'review mode' to restore private+18:00 PKT slots

monetization_guard.goal: YouTube Partner Program — channel must stay fully monetizable
rules: every episode a genuinely different topic AND different visual treatment; no templated re-voices or re-skins (inauthentic-content policy)
all assets original: engine-rendered 3D, procedurally generated sound, original scripts; never reuse another creator's footage, thumbnail, characters or voice
no voice cloning of real people; synthetic narration disclosed only if photoreal
every factual claim needs a dated authoritative source; health claims stay conservative with caveats
honest titles and thumbnails; no engagement bait; no promises of views or income
made_for_kids stays false; nothing targets children
no dangerous-stunt glorification: harmful behaviors framed as 'don't do this', with the medical evidence
QA gate (RESULT: PASS) blocks any upload; a failed gate is fixed or the day is skipped
monetization_guard.revenue_track: YPP: 1,000 subscribers + 4,000 public watch-hours OR 10M Shorts views/90 days; requires PUBLIC videos — publishAt keeps the daily cadence without missing days
monetization_guard.user_action_when_eligible: link AdSense in YouTube Studio > Earn; autopilot will flag when thresholds approach

sources.facts_bank: facts/*.json (verified, committed before each topic is filmable)
sources.research_rule: every claim needs a dated source (PubMed/CDC/NIH); no invented facts
